project_context.feature_title: Tap Destination Grouped Searchable Picker for Restaurant Admin Banner Form
project_context.design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Utility & Precision)

problem_statement_addressed: Fix Popover / Command overlap and form pushdown that pushes 'Add Banner' / 'Update Banner' off-screen
Eliminate shadcn Command defaults (white/harsh card, green active/selected states which clash with admin and conflict with active banner status)
Make Group headers (Static Pages, Categories, Items) distinct with uppercase typography, muted slate color, and crisp micro-dividers
Ensure trigger button matches native select (.admin-form-select) identically in height, padding, font-weight, background (#f1f5f9), border (#e2e8f0), and arrow affordance
Make dropdown width match trigger width (100% of container, min 240px) with single-line truncated item labels so item names never wrap awkwardly
Cap dropdown panel height to max 260px with dedicated internal smooth scroll and clear loading/empty states

structural_architecture.dropdown_panel_positioning: position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 4px); left: 0; right: 0; width: 100%; min-width: 240px; z-index: 60; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #ffffff;
structural_architecture.no_reflow_guarantee: Dropdown floats completely outside the normal document flow via absolute positioning with high z-index (z-60). Never pushes or reflows other form controls or the Add/Update Banner action button.
structural_architecture.viewport_mobile_adaptation: On 390px mobile screens, the dropdown occupies full form-group width, ensuring easy tap targets (min-height 38px per item) with no horizontal scroll.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace shadcn Popover + Command implementation in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBannersPage.jsx with the dedicated AdminDestinationPicker component pattern.

2. Ensure the trigger button uses className='admin-form-select admin-picker-trigger' so its height, background (#f1f5f9), border (#e2e8f0), font-size (14px), font-weight (500), and color (#475569) identically match other native select dropdowns like select-displayOn.

3. Set dropdown panel to position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 4px); left: 0; right: 0; width: 100%; min-width: 240px; z-index: 60; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14). This prevents reflowing the form or pushing the 'Add Banner' / 'Update Banner' button off-screen.
4. In the search input, add real-time case-insensitive filtering across label and group names. Add clear button when search input has text.
5. Render three distinct sticky group headers: 'STATIC PAGES', 'CATEGORIES', 'ITEMS' with uppercase micro-typography, muted slate (#64748b), and item count badge.

6. For selected items, apply blue-tinted background (#eff6ff), text color #1d4ed8, font-weight 600, and a blue checkmark icon (IoCheckmarkOutline). NEVER use green (#10b981 or #22c55e) because green is reserved for Active banner badges.
7. For items hover, use #f1f5f9 background and smooth transition.
8. Truncate long item names with white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; so names don't wrap and expand row heights awkwardly.
9. Set list container max-height: 220px with internal overflow-y: auto.
10. Add outside click handler (document.addEventListener('mousedown')) and Escape key listener to cleanly close the picker when clicking outside or pressing Escape.
11. Render loading spinner when pickerLoading is true, and empty state 'No destinations match...' when filtered options count is 0.
12. Keep path preview hint → {newBanner.bannerLink} rendered directly below the picker trigger.
13. In /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPages.css, add all corresponding CSS rules defined under css_rules_to_append.
14. Verify build passes with zero lint or JSX syntax errors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic full-screen gradients. Keep admin aesthetics high-contrast Swiss/clinical utility.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.2s ease).
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers. Dropdown panel background MUST be solid #ffffff with 1px border #cbd5e1.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes matching the test ids specified in testing_attributes.
Ensure mobile responsiveness down to 390px viewport without horizontal scrolling or text overflow.
